run_retrieval_evaluation_cli: run the retrieval evaluation CLI with ground truth and model score JSON files
evaluate_response_retrieval: evaluate response retrieval metrics given ground truth candidates and model-predicted scores
test_evaluate_response_retrieval: test evaluate_response_retrieval with ground truth responses and model scores for retrieval ranking
refactor_evaluate_response_retrieval: refactor evaluate_response_retrieval to support custom candidate list sizes beyond 100
review_main: review the main function that loads JSON inputs and calls evaluate_response_retrieval for retrieval metrics
